summary:
NULL pointer write in the wget applet's -T/--timeout handling
(networking/wget.c): getopt32() is handed NULL as the -T storage only when
busybox is built with CONFIG_WGET but WITHOUT CONFIG_FEATURE_WGET_TIMEOUT
("IF_NOT_FEATURE_WGET_TIMEOUT(NULL)"). Every busybox Echo ships is built
from Debian's own configs, where that combination never occurs:
debian/config/pkg/deb and debian/config/pkg/static (busybox,
busybox-static, busybox-syslogd, udhcpc, udhcpd) set
CONFIG_FEATURE_WGET_TIMEOUT=y, so -T is stored in G.timeout_seconds, and
debian/config/pkg/udeb does not build wget at all. Verified on 1:1.38.0-3:
a build from debian/config/pkg/deb and Debian's busybox and busybox-static
binaries answer "wget -T 5" and "wget --timeout 5" normally, while the same
tree with only FEATURE_WGET_TIMEOUT turned off segfaults on "wget -T 5".
The cited "patch" 83a40bf is a commit in a third-party fork, not in
upstream busybox, and bundles unrelated applet changes. Debian rates the
CVE unimportant ("crash in CLI tool, no security impact").
